answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and hence paying the relic bond on all of them and exposing each to the quill slash. Because the yarrow audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 13 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Each impostor pays 6 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
